licence.scope: ESA Science Data Centre terms for the ESA Space Science Archives, level 2 (owner's data terms), applied by analogy: the page lists ISO among the archive missions, but no statement names the ISOCAM circular-variable-filter curves. The ISO Handbook page SVO cites (http://general-tools.cosmos.esa.int/iso/manuals/HANDBOOK/cam_hb/node2.php) did not answer with curl on 2026-10-26. Non-commercial (CC BY-NC) with commercial use needing ESA authorisation, hence attribution, as in GAIA__GAIA. The ISO credit line is in the page's credit table; it is written for archive data from observing proposals and is recorded here as the owner's requested credit. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
